summary: ASTRA-MED is an autonomous clinical monitoring and medical decision-support web platform built for astronauts on long-duration space missions, such as Artemis lunar habitats and Mars transit. Exposed to NASA’s 5 Hazards of Human Spaceflight and up to 22-minute one-way communication delays with Earth, crews cannot rely on real-time ground flight surgeons during medical emergencies. Designed with consumer-grade clarity for non-medical astronauts, ASTRA-MED integrates a 12-digit Astronaut Service Number (Crew CNIC) authentication portal, a 7-sensor real-time biometric monitor, an interactive anatomical Bio-Twin, and a simulated Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS) analyzer with AI calipers. For every diagnostic exam, it provides a 4-tier clinical workflow: HOW to measure, WHY it matters in space, WHEN to alert Flight Surgeons on Earth, and WHAT immediate countermeasures to execute. It also safeguards crew privacy via an in-memory HTML5 Canvas EXIF metadata scrubber, tracks 7-Sol longitudinal trends, and gamifies daily countermeasure routines.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

ASTRA-MED (https://astra-med.health) is an autonomous crew health monitoring and clinical decision-support software engineered for long-duration spaceflight across four adaptable operational environments: (1) Spacecraft (Mars Transit - 0g, up to 22-min one-way comm delay), (2) Space Station (LEO/Gateway - 0g, real-time comm), (3) Lunar/Martian Surface Base (0.16g/0.38g partial gravity, regolith dust habitat), and (4) Surface Rover (EVA Excursion).

The system operates through five integrated workspaces:

• Astronaut Identity & "Crew CNIC" Portal: Authenticates crew members via their 12-digit Astronaut Service Number (ASN-2026-XXXX-MARS), Canadian Space Agency (CSA) Personal Dosimeter hardware serial, and blood/radiation genotype profile.

• Tab 1 — Summary & Interactive Anatomical Bio-Twin: Continuously tracks 7 core health indicators—Heart Rate (BPM), Blood Pressure (mmHg), Blood Glucose (mg/dL), Core Body Temperature (°C), Daily Sleep (hrs), Mood & Behavioral Focus (0–100), and CSA Active Radiation Dosimetry (mSv/day). Clicking any sensor or any of the 6 anatomical organ systems on the SVG Bio-Twin reveals spaceflight pathophysiology, care tier classification (Crew Self-Care vs. Alert Flight Surgeon), and closed-loop countermeasure execution.

• Tab 2 — Guided Diagnostics & Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS): Because astronauts are not all medical doctors, ASTRA-MED provides a 4-tier non-medical guide for Ocular SANS Ultrasound (measuring 5.84 mm retrobulbar optic nerve sheath dilation), Cardiac Echo (stroke volume), Femoral Bone scans, and Manual Vitals Self-Checks:

1) HOW to take the measurement step-by-step (probe placement & acoustic window).

2) WHY it matters in space (link to NASA's 5 Hazards).

3) WHEN to alert Flight Surgeons on Earth (objective clinical thresholds under comm latency).

4) WHAT immediate countermeasures to take onboard (e.g., Lower Body Negative Pressure suit at -35 mmHg, ARED resistive loading, CEVIS aerobic intervals, or storm shelter evacuation).

• Tab 3 — 7-Sol Longitudinal Health Trends & NASA 5 Hazards Matrix: Visualizes multi-Sol spline curves (Sol 120 to Sol 126) for cardiovascular drift, fasting blood glucose (microgravity insulin resistance), and cumulative radiation dose against NASA's 5 Hazards of Human Spaceflight.

• Tab 4 — Gamified Activity Rings & Habitat Routine: Prevents behavioral fatigue over multi-year voyages using concentric Readiness Rings (Vitals Stability, Exercise Compliance, Circadian Alignment), a 126-Sol habit streak counter, XP quests, and a 480nm Day / 620nm Rest circadian lighting switcher.

2. PRIVACY & SECURITY FACTORS CONSIDERED

To prevent psychological stigma and protect medical privacy in small crews (aligned with NASA-STD-3001 and HIPAA principles), ASTRA-MED features an in-memory HTML5 Canvas EXIF Metadata Scrubber. Whenever an astronaut uploads a diagnostic scan, the image is re-encoded in volatile browser RAM (canvas.toDataURL), stripping 100% of EXIF headers, GPS coordinates, camera serials, and timestamps in ~16.8 ms, alongside an on-screen Patient ID Privacy Blur toggle and AES-256 encrypted Deep Space Network (DSN) telemetry packet simulation.

3. INTENDED IMPACT & BENEFITS (IN SPACE & ON EARTH)

• In Deep Space: Enables autonomous early detection and treatment of Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), acute radiation spikes during Solar Particle Events, cardiovascular deconditioning, and circadian disruption without waiting 44 minutes for round-trip Earth communication.

• On Earth: Operates 100% offline in browser memory to empower community health workers and paramedics in remote, underserved regions—such as rural mountain clinics in Northern Pakistan (Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Balochistan), polar research stations, and disaster zones—to perform guided point-of-care diagnostics without specialist doctors.

4. TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

• Frontend & UI Architecture: JavaScript (ES6+), React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas API, and inline SVG vector medical illustrations & spline charts.

• Iconography & Design System: Lucide-React vector icons, Apple Health-inspired Light Bento human-factors design system (zero visual clutter for high-stress triage).

• Deployment & Infrastructure: Git & GitHub (https://github.com/Syedfazeel-AI/ASTRA-MED), Vercel Edge CDN, and Porkbun/GoDaddy Registry custom domain (https://astra-med.health).

5. ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) / AI GENERATION IN CODE & DATA

In full compliance with 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge Super Intelligence (SI) guidelines, Team 3 delulu Legends explicitly acknowledges that SI/AI tools (Google Gemini and Antigravity IDE) were utilized to assist in software code scaffolding (React/Tailwind components), documentation structuring, and synthetic multi-Sol physiological telemetry data simulation grounded in published NASA HRP and CSA reference ranges. No NASA logos or restricted branding elements were generated or modified.
